title: The potential of Kadsura longipedunculata against herb and chemical induced liver injury.
authors: Qin, Ma-Long; Qian, Yan-Ling; Wen, Xi; Zhao, Yun-Li; Luo, Xiao-Dong
one_liner_zh: 研究草药提取物对肝损伤的保护作用，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Kadsura longipedunculata is a Yi ethnic herb for hepatic disorders treatment in China. However, its effects on herb- and chemical-induced liver injury remain unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: To validate traditional ethnomedicinal applications of K. longipedunculata and characterize its bioactive constituents. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The hepatoprotective effect was evaluated using a triptolide-induced mice liver injury model. Bio-guided isolates were screened in an acetaminophen (APAP)-induced HepG2 cell model. Underlying signaling pathways were investigated using transcriptomics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and subsequent Western blotting validation. RESULTS: Abnormal biochemical indices, antioxidant defenses, and liver pathological necrosis in triptolide-induced mice were all adjusted by treatment with K. longipedunculata extract, exhibiting effects superior to those of the positive control, silymarin. The PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB signaling pathway was identified as a core therapeutic pathway through transcriptomic profiling, supported by the upregulation of phosphorylated AKT and MTOR concurrent with the downregulation of NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha. Four compounds were isolated, among which catechin-5-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside (Catechin GP) showed potent anti-apoptotic and antioxidative bioactivities in APAP-induced hepatocytes through the same pathway. The formation of a stable Catechin GP-AKT1 complex was further supported by computational analyses of binding stability and safety. CONCLUSION: The protective effect of K. longipedunculata and its bioactive compound, Catechin GP, against liver injury triggered by both herbal (triptolide) and chemical (acetaminophen) agents is regulated via the PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：长梗南五味子（Kadsura longipedunculata）是中国彝族用于治疗肝脏疾病的草药。然而，其对草药和化学物质诱导的肝损伤的作用尚不清楚。研究目的：验证长梗南五味子的传统民族医学应用，并表征其生物活性成分。材料与方法：使用雷公藤甲素（triptolide）诱导的小鼠肝损伤模型评估保肝作用。在乙酰氨基酚（acetaminophen, APAP）诱导的HepG2细胞模型中筛选生物活性引导分离的化合物。通过转录组学、网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟及后续Western blotting验证，研究潜在信号通路。结果：长梗南五味子提取物治疗可调节雷公藤甲素诱导小鼠的异常生化指标、抗氧化防御和肝脏病理坏死，其效果优于阳性对照水飞蓟素（silymarin）。通过转录组学分析，PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路被确定为核心治疗通路，磷酸化AKT和MTOR的上调以及NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha的下调支持了这一发现。分离出四种化合物，其中儿茶素-5-O-β-D-吡喃葡萄糖苷（catechin-5-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside, Catechin GP）在APAP诱导的肝细胞中通过相同通路表现出强效抗凋亡和抗氧化生物活性。计算分析进一步支持了稳定的Catechin GP-AKT1复合物的形成，包括结合稳定性和安全性。结论：长梗南五味子及其生物活性化合物Catechin GP对由草药（雷公藤甲素）和化学物质（乙酰氨基酚）诱导的肝损伤的保护作用通过PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB通路调控。
